as_told.title: Ultrasound and random number generator testing of psionic subjects

plain: A member of Jake Barber's team has recently made a breakthrough with an ultrasound system that works from outside the head, passing through the skull to target parts of the brain and help a person move "out of intellect and into your intuition." That is how Barber describes it in 2025. He is a helicopter pilot who says he flew a UFO retrieval, and he speaks partly from inside the team and partly from what his colleague told him. In one version he adds that test subjects are checked with random number generators, machines that produce random results which a person tries to influence, and that the work is done with a partner organization.
